founding_assay.criterion: relative increase >=20% over pre-treatment AND absolute increase >=3% of wild-type alpha-Gal A activity at 10 uM

mechanism_from_label_12_1: migalastat binds the active site of mutant alpha-Gal A, stabilises it and restores trafficking to the lysosome; it dissociates at lysosomal pH and high substrate concentration
indication_is_a_genotype_gate: indicated for adults with confirmed Fabry disease AND an amenable GLA variant based on in vitro assay data
non_amenable_clinical_result: of 67 patients in Study 1, the 17 with non-amenable variants had no change from baseline in GL-3 inclusions per kidney interstitial capillary after 6 months
real_world_amenable_fraction: commonly estimated 35-50% of Fabry patients; a 1,196-patient Latin American series reported 60.2%. Range, not a measured prevalence.
what_we_take: the shape of the deliverable: a maintained per-allele eligibility table with the assay and threshold stated
what_we_do_not_claim: parity. Theirs is assay-determined and clinically validated; ours is predicted and labelled as such.
